cli.finalMessage:
I've built the support request form in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

Notes on the approach:
- No `node_modules`/`@strata/react` API is present in the project (only `package.json` references it), so I couldn't safely guess its component props. I used plain semantic HTML (`select`, `input`, `textarea`, `fieldset`) styled to match the theme via the Strata CSS custom properties (`--strata-color-*`, `--strata-space-*`, `--strata-font-*`, `--strata-radius-*`) that are already loaded globally in `main.tsx`, each with a sensible fallback so it still looks correct if a particular token name doesn't exist.
- All spacing uses logical properties (`margin-inline`, `padding-inline`, `inset`-agnostic layout) so it works correctly in the RTL locale too.

Form behavior:
- Topic: mock list of 5 topics in a `select`.
- Subject: required text input.
- Description: textarea capped at 500 chars, showing "N characters left" (turns to an error color under 20 remaining).
- Attachment: optional file input with a remove option.
- Contact preference: radio group (Email / Phone / No preference).
- Validation on submit for all required fields; on success, the form is replaced by a confirmation view showing a mock-generated reference number (e.g. `SR-XXXXXX`) and a button to submit another request.

I can't run or typecheck the app per the instructions, so I'd recommend running `pnpm install && pnpm typecheck`/`pnpm dev` once dependencies are available to confirm everything compiles cleanly.
